ISFJ Coach v1.8.0: Major Documentation Overhaul & Strategic Update

- Rewrote and greatly expanded SKILL.md with comprehensive usage guidance, scenario handling, dual-mode logic (coach/advisor), and conversation templates.
- Clarified boundaries, success metrics, core functionalities (deep dialogue, actionable advice, growth records), and error handling principles.
- Detailed automatic mode switching criteria and output length guidelines to optimize user experience.
- Added instructions for specific ISFJ challenges (e.g., setting boundaries, self-care, action bottlenecks) with ISFJ-tailored solutions.
- Provided explicit user flow for edge cases and conversation exit/archival process.
- Established clear author responsibilities and skill improvement philosophy.
